summary: Add prompt heuristic for positive-specialist-priority and control-flow injection of roi-crop failure context.

edits.hypothesis: Adding a specific instruction to prioritize positive findings from specialized tools over negative consensus from general VQA models addresses the uncritical acceptance failure mode observed in q000002 and q000009.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The agent needs a semantic shift in how it weighs conflicting evidence, which is best achieved through system prompt instructions rather than code logic that might be too rigid.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000002, chest_xray_expert said 'No' but ground truth was 'Yes'; in q000009, chest_xray_expert said 'Yes' while others said 'No'. The new prompt instructs prioritizing the specialized positive signal (if present) or re-inspecting pixels if high-res fails. (preservative) Does not disrupt successful direct visual reasoning tasks. (transfer) Generalizes to any domain with specialized vs general tool conflicts.
edits.regression_risk: May cause over-reliance on specialized tools if they hallucinate positives, but the instruction includes 'unless visual inspection clearly contradicts it'.
edits.mechanism: Adding a specific instruction to prioritize positive findings from specialized tools over negative consensus from general VQA models addresses the uncritical acceptance failure mode observed in q000002 and q000009.

edits.hypothesis: Injecting a specific instruction into the observation stream when roi_crop fails reinforces the prompt-level heuristic at the point of failure, ensuring the agent sees the guidance when it matters most.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prompt edits alone may be forgotten or diluted in long contexts; injecting context at the failure point ensures immediate relevance.
edits.trigger_condition: When roi_crop tool fails with a KeyError or similar infrastructure error.

(preservative) Only activates on failure, so successful crops are unaffected. (transfer) Applicable to any tool failure where high-res evidence is critical.
edits.regression_risk: Adds token overhead to failed steps, but minimal impact on success cases.

log.summary: Add prompt instruction to prioritize specialized positive findings over general VQA negative consensus.

edits.hypothesis: Adding an explicit rule to prioritize specialized tool positives (e.g., chest_xray_expert) over general VQA negatives addresses the 'uncritical acceptance' failure mode where agents ignore expert signals in favor of majority-vote negatives from less capable models.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The agent's reasoning logic is driven by the system prompt; without this explicit heuristic, it defaults to consensus or verifier approval which may be biased towards negative findings in ambiguous cases.
edits.trigger_condition: Always active for M-arm tasks using the AGENT_SYSTEM prompt.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000002 and q000009, the agent ignored chest_xray_expert's 'Yes' in favor of multiple 'No' votes from general VQAs; this rule would have forced it to treat the 'Yes' as primary evidence. (preservative) Does not affect cases where all tools agree or where visual inspection clearly contradicts the specialized tool. (transfer) Generalizes to any domain with hierarchical tool reliability.
edits.regression_risk: May cause over-reliance on a single specialized tool if it hallucinates a positive, but the existing 'verify against original pixels' instruction mitigates this.
